chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about recitation on Friday when I pray alone four [rak'ahs], do I recite audibly? He said, 'Yes.' And he said, 'Recite Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Al-Munafiqun on Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended recitation for individual Friday prayers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Hammad al-Halabi, establishing the Sunnah for individual Friday prayers to include audible recitation of Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Al-Munafiqun. This specific pairing highlights the thematic link between the gathering of the faithful and the characteristics of the hypocrites, reinforcing the spiritual preparation for the weekly congregational prayer.
